description: VS Code typings track the minimum supported editor, not an independent library.
Raise this ceiling together with `engines.vscode` and the Electron/Node target asserted by editors/vscode/esbuild.mjs.
ADR-0034: a new stable is a signal for a maintainer, not an update to merge unattended.

Renovate bumps rust-toolchain.toml, mise.toml, and the rust-toolchain action inputs, but not the `rust@` install pins in the workflows and the Justfile, so `xtask msrv check` holds this pull request red until a maintainer syncs them.
Kept apart, it cannot hold back the automerged group.
